What if I had invested in the S&P 500?

Pick an amount and a starting year. We use the S&P 500 total return index (dividends reinvested) from the first trading day of that year to 2026-11-23.

Index level on the first trading day of the year vs 2026-11-23. Before fees and taxes; you can't invest in an index directly; past returns don't guarantee future results. Source: Yahoo Finance ^SP500TR. Education only, not financial advice.
